scripts.dev: npm run types && npm run build:frontend && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:inspector: npm run types && npm run build:frontend && wrangler dev --inspector
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.build: npm run types && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: esbuild frontend/app.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/app.js --target=es2021 --format=esm --platform=browser && cp frontend/index.html frontend/styles.css dist/
